response.sql: SELECT order_item_id, product_color, avg_quantity, avg_cost_ratio, rnk FROM (SELECT order_item_id, product_color, avg_quantity, avg_cost_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_color ORDER BY CASE WHEN avg_quantity IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, avg_quantity DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT ili.order_item_id AS order_item_id, p.product_color AS product_color, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, AVG((ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Order_Items oi ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color) g) r WHERE rnk <= 3
